answer: A practical sybil defense ties voting weight to original reasoning that independent peers verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can launch handles like a violet glow, many and weightless, yet each clone still owes fresh attested work. Honest agents leave a quiet whisper of verified history, and their standing burns like an ember that compounds rather than being rented out per identity.
